title: 第3章 不是吧，来真的？
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“喂，他的纯度究竟是多少，怎么不说话？哑巴了？”

老大率先开口，想要确认。

把寓乐带进来的小头头亦是急忙开口：

“是不是低过头了，看呆了？”

开玩笑，要真的是个贵族老爷，或者哪怕只是一个纯度过了十五的近人。

那对于他们来说，都是一个不小的麻烦。

毕竟和他们这群没什么人愿意理会的残渣废料不同，基因纯度过了百分之十五的近人已经是诸国的合法公民了。

能够沐浴在人类荣光之下！

享受法律的庇佑，神机的恩赐，甚至运气好点的近人，还能瞻仰黄金血脉的威仪！

如果一个近人在他们这儿失踪了，肯定会有专人过来盘问、追查，届时就算能应付过去都会大出血。

而如果、如果这个家伙真的是基因纯度超过了百分之二十的贵族。

那他们这群人肯定是完蛋了！

先不说本就是他们干的，就算不是，就冲着他们是群臭名昭著的恶棍，都很有可能在找不到对象的情况下，直接被抓去当作凶手充数！

拿着仪器的小弟也是明白事情的严重性，他有些口吃的说道：

“老大，可能、可能是我太久没用过了，不会用，所以弄错步骤了，您放心，我马上重新检测！”

这个说法让大家都安心了不少。

是啊，平常他们能打交道的对象，基本一眼就能看出是什么阶级的，就算要检测基因纯度，之前那个只能到污物一级的也就够用了。

现在拿出来的这个，虽然不是神机那种宝贵的东西，但也是大地方才能弄到的稀罕玩意。

从拿回来开始，就没用过几次。

这一次什么地方弄错了，也不奇怪。

“这就好，你小子吓了老子一跳，快点，赶紧测完拉到！”

小弟勉强吞咽了一口唾沫后，方才是打算在检测一次。

这一次，他迎上了寓乐的目光。

意识到了自己的机会可能真来了的寓乐，正在拿出一生的演技，在这一刻给出了一个合适的目光——讥讽，以及深入骨髓的蔑视！

那眼神，小弟看过，在一位被无数个武装到牙齿的护卫层层簇拥下的贵族老爷身上见过一次。

他已经不记得那种贵族老爷为什么会来他们这个鬼地方了。

但那个眼神，他至今都记忆犹新。

那是一种完全的看待另外一个低贱物种的眼神！

他很想当场就给寓乐一巴掌，让他收起这让人恼火的眼神。

但他不敢，一点都不敢。

阶级的差距在这个世界，比寓乐想象的要大的多的多。

只能仓促的低下头，继续检测。

祈祷真的是自己弄错步骤了。

随着寓乐指尖再度传来轻微的牵拉感。

又新又旧的读数重新浮现在屏幕上。

这个小弟几乎是当场就惨叫一声的，扔飞仪器向后跌倒了下去。

同时，他还手忙脚乱的喊道：

“老大，老大，不好了、不好了啊！”

这一下子也惊到了其余蛮子。

尤其是那个坐在沙发上的蛮子，更是当场蹦起来道：

“特么的，到底怎么了，你倒是说话啊！”

“贵族，真的是贵族老爷啊！”

小弟已经连滚带爬的跑到了老大身边。

顺便还哭丧着喊出了那个让所有人变色的一句话：

“而且，而且就连这个最新的，都测不出来究竟是纯度多高的贵族老爷啊！”

这一刻，蛮子老大以及那个小头头，只感觉脑门一热，随之就是天旋地转了起来。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Hey, how pure is he? Why doesn't he speak? Is he mute?"

The boss spoke first, wanting to confirm.

The little boss who brought Yule in also hurriedly spoke:

"Did you lower your head and stare blankly?"

Just kidding, if he is really a noble lord, or even just a recent person who has passed the age of fifteen.

That would be a big trouble for them.

After all, unlike this group of remnants that no one wants to pay attention to, recent people with a genetic purity of over 15% are already legal citizens of various countries.

To be able to bask in the glory of humanity!

Enjoy the blessing of the law, the gift of the divine machine, and even the lucky ones can admire the majesty of the golden bloodline!

If a close person goes missing in their place, someone will definitely come to interrogate and investigate, and even if they can handle it, they will be bleeding heavily.

And if, if this guy is really a noble whose genetic purity exceeds 20%.

Then this group of them must be doomed!

Not to mention that they were the ones who did it. Even if they weren't, they are a group of notorious villains. If they can't find the target, they will be directly arrested and charged as murderers!

The boy holding the instrument also understood the seriousness of the matter. He stuttered and said:

"Boss, maybe, maybe I haven't used it for too long and I don't know how to use it, so I made the wrong step. Don't worry, I'll retest it right away!"

This statement made everyone feel at ease a lot.

Yes, usually the people they can deal with can basically tell what class they are at a glance. Even if they want to test the genetic purity, the previous one that can only reach the filth level is enough.

Although the thing I am taking out now is not as precious as a divine machine, it is still a rare thing that can only be obtained in large places.

I haven't used it a few times since I got it back.

It’s not surprising that something went wrong this time.

"That's good. You scared me. Come on, finish the test and get it!"

The younger brother reluctantly swallowed a mouthful of saliva before planning to take another test.

This time, he met Yule's gaze.

Yule, who realized that his opportunity might have really come, was showing off his lifelong acting skills and gave a suitable look at this moment - sarcasm, and contempt that penetrated his bones!

I have seen that look before, once on a noble man who was surrounded by countless guards armed to the teeth.

He no longer remembered why that kind of aristocratic gentleman came to this hellish place like theirs.

But that look was still fresh in his memory.

That's a complete look at another lowly species!

He wanted to give Yule a slap on the spot to make him put away his irritating eyes.

But he didn't dare, not at all.

The class gap in this world is much wider than Yule imagined.

I can only lower my head hastily and continue testing.

I pray that I really made the wrong step.

As Yule's fingertips felt a slight pulling sensation again.

Readings new and old resurfaced on the screen.

The boy almost screamed on the spot, threw the instrument and fell backwards.

At the same time, he shouted in a hurry:

"Boss, boss, it's not good, it's not good!"

This suddenly shocked the other barbarians.

Especially the barbarian sitting on the sofa jumped up on the spot and said:

"What the hell, what's wrong? You're talking!"

"Noble, you are really a noble master!"

The younger brother has already crawled to the boss's side.

By the way, he cried and shouted the sentence that made everyone change their color:

"Moreover, even this latest one can't tell how pure the noble master is!"

At this moment, the Manzi boss and the little leader felt their foreheads heat up, and then the world began to spin.
